newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal to buy Owen in $496 million stock deal.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal to buy Owen in $496 million stock deal.

text.p: Health care service provider Cardinal Health Inc. will acquire hospital pharmacy service provider Owen Healthcare Inc. in a stock deal valued at $496 million, the companies said Wednesday.
Under the agreement, Cardinal will offer 0.315 share of its common stock for each Owen share in a tax-free pooling of interests, as long as Cardinal trades between $82.175 and $90.825 a share.
The exchange ratio will be 0.3316 if Cardinal shares fall below $82.175, and 0.3 if they rise above $90.825.
Cardinal slid $2.125 to close at $84.375 on the New York Stock Exchange. Owen jumped $8.125 to $24.875 after being halted for the announcement.
At Cardinal stock's current level, the deal values Owen at about $26.70 a share.

The companies also said they would call off the deal if Cardinal's shares fell below $69.20. Dublin, Ohio-based Cardinal has an option to buy up to 19.9 percent of Owen's stock under certain circumstances if the deal does not close.
Cardinal will issue between 5.49 million and 6.07 million fully diluted common shares in the transaction, they said.

"This combination will significantly strengthen our capabilities to provide value-added services to hospitals and provide substantial cross-marketing opportunities among Owen's and Cardinal's businesses," said Cardinal Chairman Robert Walter.
""As a result of the merger with Cardinal, Owen will be able to offer its customers an extended range of health care services which should provide additional efficiencies and growth opportunities."
Walter said the merger will provide significant synergies, and is not expected to reduce Cardinal's earnings.
The companies expect the deal to close in the first quarter of 1997.

Owen is the nation's leading provider of fully integrated contract hospital pharmacy management services, with about 330 hospital pharmacy customers in 43 states. Cardinal provides a wide range of pharmaceutical products and services nationwide.
